facilityDetails.programFocus: Helps individuals with disabilities build independent living, social, and job skills through community integration and supported work environments.

fundingMechanics.fundingSourceCategory: Regional Center / Dept. of Developmental Services (DDS)
fundingMechanics.financialCoverageNote: Services are 100% state-funded for eligible clients whose IPP explicitly authorizes this placement. Transportation and ancillary services may require separate authorization from your Regional Center service coordinator.

parentReviews: Reviewers praise the highly structured environment and the variety of social, educational, and entertaining activities provided.
The location is noted for having a fully trained, professional staff that helps clients maintain their independence and high quality of life.
Because it operates under the large Sevita/MENTOR corporate umbrella, some families note that the intake and administrative paperwork can feel highly bureaucratic.

facilityDetails.programFocus: A site-based adult day program with a strong emphasis on behavior management, teaching social skills curriculums, and providing integration into supported work environments.

fundingMechanics.fundingSourceCategory: Regional Center / Dept. of Developmental Services (DDS)
fundingMechanics.financialCoverageNote: Behavioral support services under Service Code 515 require a behavior support plan approved by your Regional Center. Full cost coverage applies when the service is authorized in the client's IPP.

parentReviews: Client care is highly praised; reviewers note that the agency provides excellent, individualized care and that client needs are met in every area of their life.
The program is well-regarded for safely handling clients who require specialized behavioral management and structured routines.
Online employee reviews indicate high management turnover, which parents should note as it can occasionally impact daily staff consistency.

facilityDetails.programFocus: Provides vocational resources and training for adults with developmental disabilities, focusing heavily on supervised work skills and local job placement.

fundingMechanics.fundingSourceCategory: Regional Center / Dept. of Developmental Services (DDS)
fundingMechanics.financialCoverageNote: Vocational day program services are fully state-funded via DDS when listed in the client's IPP. Supported employment job coaching may be billed separately under an additional authorization code.

parentReviews: Highly rated for its direct focus on vocational training; reviewers appreciate that clients are integrated into actual work environments (like warehouse tasks and fulfillment).
The program maintains strong corporate partnerships (e.g., e.l.f. beauty, GEODIS) to provide real-world, supervised employment opportunities.
Because the focus is heavily on repetitive, routine tasks for vocational training, it is best suited for individuals specifically looking for employment skills rather than purely social recreation.

facilityDetails.programFocus: Provides comprehensive day services aimed at promoting independence, community involvement, and life skills development for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

fundingMechanics.fundingSourceCategory: Regional Center / Dept. of Developmental Services (DDS)
fundingMechanics.financialCoverageNote: As a certified DDS vendor, all core day services are fully state-funded when the program is written into the client's IPP. Wrap-around therapies (speech, OT, PT) offered on-site may be covered separately through Medi-Cal or private insurance.

parentReviews: Families feel highly secure working with a massive, trusted national brand that utilizes standardized care protocols and safety measures.
The center is praised for offering a wide variety of wrap-around services beyond just day care, including speech and physical therapies.
Due to the massive scale of the organization, the environment can feel very clinical, but the staff is highly trained in managing transitions.
